data.narrative:
Chemify, a Series B-stage biotech company founded by Leroy Cronin, has raised $93M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 8 private-stage peers in Biotech & Health plus 3 public sector benchmarks (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $93M total raised as a proxy base, implying a $177M valuation. The peer-median approach anchors to 4 same-sector peers at identical or adjacent stages—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B)—yielding a median of $3.5B with a range of $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (sector median 6.6x across 3 tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue data.

The triangulated range is $150M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B across the two applicable methods. The peer-median approach drives the upper-end estimate; stage-progression anchors the lower bound. Key uncertainties include the wide valuation dispersion among peer Series C rounds ($3.1B–$10.3B) and the limited applicability of public comparables without revenue visibility.
